messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security acceptance milestones and MAP for ClearPay close

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, I’m attaching a draft mutual action plan and a security checklist that maps the evaluation gates we need to clear for a production go-live. High-level asks from ClearPay we captured: SOC 2 attestation, SIG/CAIQ questionnaire, DPA signed, and confirmation of retention/residency windows.

Deliverables we propose and target dates (draft):
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (we can provide the report/attestation stub) — target 2026-11-10
- SIG/CAIQ survey completion (Redwood to return answers, ClearPay to confirm review) — target 2026-11-17
- DPA redlines and final sign-off (DocuSign link to follow) — target 2026-11-12
- Data retention/residency confirmation (tiers for logs vs. user data) — target 2026-11-09

A couple of clarifying notes up-front:
- Hosted API vs Dedicated/Private: if you need private tenancy or EU residency, that affects the lead time and which gates are mandatory.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys on Private deployments; hosted customers can use Redwood-managed KMS with contractual controls.

I’ve attached: redwood_draft_map_v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), partial_caicq_responses.pdf (work-in-progress), soc2_attestation_stub.pdf (redacted).

Next step: can you confirm which items are critical path for procurement and whether the proposed dates look reasonable? Happy to update the MAP and book an acceptance review call.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Hannah —

Appreciate the draft. A few quick clarifications from our side:
1) SOC 2: we require a SOC 2 Type II report covering the most recent 12 months. Will your stub be followed by the full report?
2) SIG/CAIQ: good to see a partial — what percent complete is that? We usually expect a completed CAIQ before contract execution.
3) DPA: our legal team prefers to exchange redlines early. Can you confirm who on your side will own DPA redlines?
4) Retention: we operate under a 7-year retention baseline for financial data; is that feasible as an exception or will we need an escrow/archival workflow?

We’ll upload the vendor security questionnaire to our procurement portal (link below) — please confirm the point people and we’ll route the DocuSign once redlines are resolved.

Portal: https://vendor.clearpay.com/requests/CLP-2026-087

Thanks,
Dan
Director, Procurement
ClearPay Financial

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Reid <daniel.reid@clearpay.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:37:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Security acceptance milestones and MAP for ClearPay close

Thanks Dan — quick technical clarifications and proposed gating to make the procurement runway concrete.

SOC 2: the stub attached contains the auditor name, coverage period, and scope. We will provide the full Type II report (redacted for customer-specific items) by 2026-11-10.

SIG/CAIQ: the PDF is ~65% complete. We can finish the remaining sections within two business weeks if you can provide the clarifying items listed in tab 3 of the MAP (data flows and third-party connections). Proposed completion 2026-11-17.

DPA redlines: Naomi will own legal coordination and intake. Naomi, can you confirm happy path for the 72-hour turn on initial redlines?

Retention/Escrow: operational notes — we support: 
- Short-term logs and telemetry: default 90 days (configurable)
- Customer data (indexed records): configurable 0–7 years depending on plan
- Long-term archival: available via object storage export (we can automate exports to your S3 bucket or provide encrypted export)

If ClearPay requires 7-year retention on primary production index data, that’s an opt-in configuration; it adds storage and monthly cost. If you require key escrow for encrypted PII, we’ll need the Private deployment or a dedicated KMS arrangement — timeline estimate +10 business days for KMS onboarding.

Proposed MAP gating (concrete dates):
- 2026-11-09: Confirm retention tiers and residency requirement
- 2026-11-10: Provide SOC 2 Type II full report (redacted)
- 2026-11-12: DPA redlines exchanged (Naomi owns)
- 2026-11-17: SIG/CAIQ completed and returned
- 2026-11-19: Decision point on Dedicated vs Hosted (impacts cutover plan)
- 2026-11-24: Final acceptance call / sign-off (target)

We’ve attached latest artifacts (soc2_attestation_stub.pdf and partial_caicq_responses.pdf). Happy to walk through on a short call — propose Thursday 11/5 10:00am PT if that works for you.

—Marcus
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
